newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Ministers fail to agree new veterinary agency status.
newsitem.headline: Ministers fail to agree new veterinary agency status.

text.p: Farm ministers failed on Monday to agree on the status and funding of a new EU veterinary inspection agency in Ireland, officials said.
"The Presidency asked COREPER to clear it by the next council in November," an official said.
But the official added that the European Parliament was unlikely to have given its opinion by then so a final decision would not be possible next month.
The Commission has proposed the creation of an independent agency which would be part funded by veterinary inspection fees.
The cost would range from 7.2 million Ecus for an office with 64 staff, to 11.5 million Ecus for an office with 100 staff.
Germany, supported by many member states, want the office to remain under Commission control and funded from the EU budget.
